Archive what normalize rejected beside the invoices

GET /api/v1/finance/workflows/monthly-in.text:
# finance/monthly-invoicing
apiVersion: agentiik.dev/v1
kind: Workflow

metadata:
  name: monthly-invoicing
  namespace: finance

include:
  - common-bricks.yaml

inputs:
  orders:
    schema: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
    required: true
  customers:
    schema: { type: array }
    default: []

outputs:
  invoices: { from: { step: archive, port: ok }, retain: 90d }
  errors: { from: { step: invoice, port: error }, retain: { for: 7d, fetches: 3 } }

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 1 * *"
      timezone: Europe/Paris
  webhook:
    - path: invoicing/rerun

concurrency:
  group: monthly-invoicing

timeout: 6h

steps:

  normalize:
    image: ghcr.io/acme/agk-normalize:1.4.0
    inputs:
      orders: ${{ workflow.inputs.orders }}
      customers: ${{ workflow.inputs.customers }}
    params:
      currency: ${{ vars.currency }}
    outputs: [ok, rejected]

  invoice:
    extends: .api-brick
    image: ghcr.io/acme/agk-invoice:3.2.1
    needs:
      - { step: normalize, port: ok, as: in }
    if: ${{ inputs.in.count > 0 }}
    strategy:
      fan_out: item
      max_parallel: 8
    params:
      rounding: per_line
    secrets: [billing]
    outputs: [out, error]

  archive:
    image: ghcr.io/acme/agk-archive:0.9.0
    needs:
      - { step: invoice, port: out, as: invoices }
      - { step: normalize, port: rejected, as: rejected }
    merge: wait_all
    cache: true
    outputs: [ok]
